title: [Doujinshi] [Aoyagi Kabota] Ie o tsuihou saretemo tsuite kite kureta konyakusha ga inmon no saiin ni kusshite hoka no otoko no mono ni nacchau yatsu | My fiancée who followed me even after I was banished ends up giving in to the lewd crest’s curse and becomes another man’s woman [English] [Aishi21]
